verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs describe frozen-lockfile installs (default in CI, failing if the lockfile is stale) and a content-addressable, hard-linked store that guarantees identical resolved package files across machines, and multiple community reports confirm consistent, fast, reproducible installs in real projects/monorepos. Missing for 10: an independent third-party audit specifically verifying byte-identical resolution across machines, and one community comment (pnpm-comm-15) prefers yarn3 for reproducibility, giving a minor secondary caveat.
